newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler shares hit all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Daimler shares hit all-time high.

text.p: Shares in Daimler-Benz AG, Germany's largest industrial group, jumped 2.2 percent to an all-time high of 142.40 marks in pre-bourse trade on Wednesday after the company forecast a further rise in operating profit this year.
Daimler's shares rose 3.10 marks to 142.40 marks in the shortly after trading started.

They later pared their gains and were trading at 140.40 marks at 0655 GMT, up 1.10 marks, outperforming the overall IBIS DAX index which was up 0.12 percent or 4.12 points at 3,373.38 at the same time.
Daimler reported a 12 percent rise in sales in the first quarter to 25.9 billion marks and said it expected another increase in operating profit for 1997.
The automotive, aerospace and financial services group holds its annual results news conference today at 0800 GMT.
